data.title: Trump Jokes Stephen Miller Was ‘Better Than’ Vance, Rubio, Asks If He Wants to Run for President: ‘He Will Destroy Their Two Political Careers,’ Says Scaramucci
data.description: Trump jokingly suggested Stephen Miller could run for president, praising him over Vance and Rubio during a White House briefing.

data.title: Chuck Schumer Says Trump, Lutnick ‘Sold Out America’ by Approving Nvidia, AMD AI Chip Sales to China: ‘They Get Rich and America Gets Screwed’
data.description: Schumer slammed Trump for approving nearly 880,000 AI chip exports to Chinese companies, citing national security risks.

data.title: Trump’s Cybersecurity Agency Pick Faces Senate Roadblock After Thom Tillis Blocks Nomination Over Capitol ‘Attack’ Denial
data.description: Sen. Thom Tillis blocks Trump’s CISA nominee after Michael LoSapio said he did not believe Jan. 6 was an attack.

data.title: Waymo Robotaxis Face 2 Recalls Over Closed Freeway Lane Violations, Traffic Control Issues
data.description: Waymo is recalling its robotaxis over freeway lane violations and traffic-control issues, adding to safety concerns.

data.title: Trump Has A Message for Big Tech Firms Like Amazon, Google and Microsoft Building Data Centers Abroad: ‘We’re Going to Put A Tremendous Tax On Them’
data.description: Trump threatened heavy taxes on U.S. tech companies building data centers overseas to keep AI investments at home.
